verses.en: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.sm: Koru. O le salámo. Ina patipati ia o outou lima, o outou nuu uma lava;

verses.en: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.sm: ina alalaga atu ¡a i le Atua ma le leo fiafia. A4a e matautia le ALII le Silisili ese;

verses.en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.sm: E faatoilaloina e ia o nuu ia te i tatou, ma nuu ese i lalo o tatou vae.

verses.en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.sm: E filifilia e ia le tofi mo i tatou, o le mea e mitamita ai lakopo, na ia alofa i ai. Sela.

verses.en: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.sm: O loo afio ae le Atua ma le alaga fiafia, o loo afio ae le ALII ma le leo o le pu.

verses.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.sm: Ina pepese atu ia i le Atua, ina pepese ia; ina pepese atu ia i lo tatou Tupu, ina pepese ia.

verses.en: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.sm: Auā o le Atua, o le Tupu ia o le lalolagi atoa; ina pepese atu ia ma le atamai.

verses.en: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.sm: Ua fai ta tupu le Atua i nuu ese; o loo tietie le Atua i lona nofoálii paia.

verses.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.sm: Ua faatasia alii o nuu i le nuu o le Atua o Aperaamo; to auaeo le Atua talita o le lalolagi; e matuā silisili ese lava o ia.
